subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

XY_XY_ _ZXYX_ _XYXY_ _ _
solution:
__**Option 2**__ is the correct answer.

**Given**: XY_XY_ _ZXYX_ _XYXY_ _ _

Lets check each option.

1) Y,X,Y,Y,Z,Z,X,Y → XY__Y__XY - __XY__ZXY - X__YZ__XY - XY__ZXY__

__
 
• No pattern followed.

2) Z,X,Y,Y,Z,Z,X,Y →** XYZ__XY - __XY__ZXY - X__YZ__XY - XY__ZXY__**

__
 
• XYZXY is repeating itself.

3) Z,X,Y,Y,Z,Z,X,Z → XYZ__XY - __XY__ZXY - X__YZ__XY - XY__ZXZ__

__
 
• No pattern followed.

4) Z,Y,Y,Y,Z,Z,X,Y → XYZ__XY - __YY__ZXY - X__YZ__XY - XY__ZXY__

 
• No pattern followed.

Hence, **"ZXYYZZXY"** is the correct answer.
